pages.en:
“What was—I…”

What was I doing?

For a moment, I gave in to the impulse and unwound the cloth.

I cannot understand what happened after that.

What became of me?

What was I about to become?

It happened only seconds ago, yet I cannot remember any of it—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Whatwas I doing?”
What was I doing?
I unwrapped the cloth because of this sudden idea.
I don’t understand what happened after that.
What has been done to me.
What will be done to me.
It only happened a few seconds ago, but I can’t remember at all

pages.ja:
「
ダメだ。これは、本当に」
解けば死ぬ。
神父の言葉は真実だ。
何がどうなるかは判らないが、この布の下にあるものは、俺の物ではなくなっている。

pages.en:
“—No. This really is…”

If I uncover it, I will die.

The priest spoke the truth.

I don't know what happens or how, but whatever lies beneath this cloth is no longer mine.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“This is bad. It’s really…”
I’ll die if I release it.
The priest’s words were true.
I don’t know what’ll happen, but what’s under this cloth is not mine.

「……忘れろ。ただ腕が動かないだけだ。……これ以上考えれば、きっと」
恐怖で、切れ味が鈍くなる。
そんな醜態は許されない。
アーチャーの腕を移植してまで生き延びたのは、無様に怯える為じゃない。

pages.en:
“…Forget it. It's only an arm that won't move. …If I think about it any further, I know…”

Fear will dull my edge.

I cannot permit myself that disgrace.

I did not survive by having Archer's arm grafted onto me merely to cower in terror.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……Forget about it. It’s just that my arm doesn’t move. …If I think about it any more, I’ll…”
I’ll slow down because of fear.
That’s not allowed.
Archer’s arm wasn’t transplanted onto me so that I could cower in fear.

pages.ja:
「……そうだ。今は俺の腕なんかより、桜の事を考えないと」
桜は朝と変わらなかったが、いつ倒れるか判らない。
……その前に臓硯を倒して聖杯を手に入れる。
考えるべきはその方法だ。
片腕で臓硯とアサシンを倒す手段。
……いや、敵はそれだけじゃない。
俺たちの前には得体の知れない敵がいる。

pages.en:
“…That's right. I need to think about Sakura now, not my arm.”

Sakura seemed no different from this morning, but she could collapse at any moment.

…Before that happens, we must defeat Zouken and obtain the Holy Grail.

The question is how.

How to defeat Zouken and Assassin with only one arm.

…No, they are not our only enemies.

Something unknowable stands in our path.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…That’s right. I have to think about Sakura instead of my arm.”
Sakura wasn’t that different from this morning, but I don’t know when she might collapse.
…I have to defeat Zouken and obtain the Holy Grail before that.
I have to think about how to do that.
A way to beat Zouken and Assassin with one arm.
…No, they aren’t the only enemies.
There are the mysterious enemies too.

pages.en:
“………………”

…The truth is, I know.

There is no hope of victory anywhere.

I don't even know what will become of the dull pain in my arm.

The difference in strength is overwhelming, and I can no longer be certain even of myself.

How much can I possibly do to protect Sakura like this—?
